universe: 200 current constituents in nifty200.csv, snapshot on 2026-09-23; historical membership unavailable

weekly_screen.sma200_rising: 13 consecutive weekly increases, evaluated on completed weekly closes
weekly_screen.new_high_frequency: At least one fresh 252-session high in each of the last two 26-week blocks; no gap between those high weeks, including endpoints, exceeds 26 weeks
weekly_screen.weekly_data: Full exchange weeks ending Friday; incomplete last week excluded; missing stock sessions invalidate weekly candle
weekly_screen.vcp: Alternating confirmed weekly pivots, one bar on each side; outside bars reset sequence; same-type pivots retain most extreme
weekly_screen.contractions: Declining high-to-low percentage depths, rising lows, non-increasing high-to-low durations; final pullback mean volume below prior rally mean, final pullback below prior pullback mean, aggregate up-week volume above down-week volume
weekly_screen.pattern_age: First high 4-26 weeks ago; last low at most 8 weeks ago; final low unbroken and no previous close above final swing high
weekly_screen.liquidity: Prior 20-session average rupee turnover >= Rs 1 crore; assumed execution guard, not a supplied Minervini rule

entry_rules.intraday_pivot: Weekly-known final swing high * 1.001 buy-stop; gap entry at open, otherwise trigger. No same-day volume filter.
entry_rules.close_volume_next_open: Fresh daily close above weekly-known final swing high, volume >= 1.5x prior 50-session average; enter next session open. Friday uses previous week's list.
entry_rules.both: Entry <= 1.05x pivot, and >= pivot; one initial entry per pattern; signal lists refreshed only after weekly close; no entries on terminal evaluation date
entry_rules.market_filter: Prior completed Nifty 200 close > its SMA200; unavailable benchmark blocks entries
entry_rules.stop: Initial entry minus min(2 * prior Wilder ATR20, 10% of entry); actual fills include adverse slippage
entry_rules.adding: At most one add on a NEW higher VCP pivot after a close at least 1R above original entry; add risk <= 0.25% equity, combined open stop risk <= 0.5% equity; never average down

exit_rules.atr_trail: Ratchet stop using highest completed close since entry minus 2*ATR20; only effective next session; never lower initial stop
exit_rules.weekly_sma10: Keep initial stop; completed weekly close below 10-week SMA schedules exit next session open
exit_rules.target_3r: Keep initial stop; limit sell at initial entry plus 3*initial stop distance
exit_rules.execution: Gap below stop exits at worse open; same-bar stop and target resolves stop-first; entry-day ambiguous stop also stop-first; period end liquidates at close; no artificial holding-time cap

portfolio.ranking: Smaller final contraction, then higher prior 20-day turnover, then symbol; known before today's open
portfolio.units: Whole adjusted-price research units; not broker-reconciled historical share counts

costs.note: Conservative delivery scenario, not historical broker invoices; personal income tax excluded; stress doubles all costs and reruns portfolio

selection: Rank using development and validation only. Prefer both profitable with >=20 closed trades in each; then maximize the smaller CAGR/max(drawdown,5%) across those periods; ties config ID. Freeze choice before calculating later period.
reporting: Show all 72 variants, costs, annual and period returns, complete trade logs, drawdown, exposure, profit factor, R expectancy, selection versus hindsight-best, and block-bootstrap uncertainty. Never optimize on later data.
limits: Current-member survivorship bias; no claim of point-in-time Nifty 200 profitability
Image uses earnings and sales; no dated fundamental filter is available, so this tests supplied price/volume rules only
Mechanical weekly VCP proxy, not an exact replay of discretionary Minervini trading
Yahoo adjusted prices approximate dividend reinvestment; actual broker quantities, dividends, circuit locks and auction execution not reconstructed
Later period is retrospective and has appeared in previous project research; not pristine unseen or prospective validation
4-8 weeks described as usual timing, not enforced as a hard cap; compare tighter time window as separately labelled sensitivity
No asserted 50% win rate, 413% return, or guaranteed profit
sources: User-supplied rules and Kenneth Cole Productions 1995 image
